features: Rust Google Workspace license-assignment reader bound to customer, product and SKU
Google service-account JWT with delegated administrator and fixed Licensing scope
Rust GitHub Copilot billed-seat reader bound to one organization and API version 2026-03-10
Protected-file manual probe emits summary counts without identities or secrets

checks.postgresFulfillmentTests: not repeated; this change adds no database path

limits: No real Google Workspace, GitHub Copilot or Microsoft provider credential/consent/live connection was used.
The new probe does not write the database, import catalog entries, allocate capacity or run a synchronization worker.
Google Licensing uses the broader apps.licensing scope; the connector performs only GET calls to the license endpoint.
Rust HTTP fixtures and Node process-contract fixtures were tested separately; live artifact smoke used invalid tokens rejected before network.
Pagination is bounded to 1000 rows and cannot guarantee an atomic snapshot during concurrent provider changes.
GitHub Copilot API is in public preview; Enterprise Server and GHE.com hosts are not supported.
The pre-existing OpenBao synchronization outage was not repaired.
